patient.history_present_illness: Mr. Brown is a 61-year-old African American man with ESRD on hemodialysis who is brought by ambulance in active status epilepticus after his wife called 911. She reports he missed his scheduled dialysis session yesterday due to transportation issues. He last had dialysis 4 days ago (his Monday session was missed and it is now Wednesday). He had been feeling increasingly confused and nauseated over the past 24 hours. He developed a generalized tonic-clonic seizure approximately 20 minutes ago that has not stopped. He has no prior history of seizures or epilepsy. His wife reports he drank significantly more fluids than usual yesterday because he felt thirsty.
